config.noise: max(side residual RMS about side-mean interpolated line, robust adjacent-difference noise)
config.max_internal_gap: max(3*cadence,.5*duration), tested separately in core and both sides
config.flag: supported and signed contrast>=5 and signed depth>=.001
config.retention: four dips and two brightenings per sector; flag-eligible ranked before others; suppress overlapping duration windows

selection: All cached targets absent accepted ledger and scientific review register; controls separate. No period/G/noise/coverage outcome cut. Sorted numeric TIC. Includes historically screened and newly screened targets; explicit method revisit, not pristine sky.
